setup_sub: We use this to show offers, harvest time and prices for you.
name: Your name
season_price: Expected price in your harvest weeks
alert_text: Rain expected in 2 days. Harvest ripe fruit early and keep crates covered.
tip_text: Prices fall about {p}% from your first to last harvest week. Sell your best fruit early.
escalation: Price rises up to {p}% if supply is tight
commit_q: How many tons will you give? (max {max})
over_commit: That is more than your free capacity ({max} t).
bond_created: Draft agreement created. Please review and sign.
share_title: Where Alphonso is sold (share of exports)
dem_fc: Expected demand in 2026: {v} tons ({g} vs last year)
gap_msg: Singapore needs more than FPOs can supply: shortage of {g} tons. Good chance to sell.
grade_need: Which quality is needed in Singapore

gB: Grade B – medium (250–300 g), small marks
price_title: Expected price through the season (₹ per kg)
price_note: Prices are highest at the start and fall when more mangoes arrive. Shaded band = likely range.
compare_title: Compare offers (₹ per kg, Grade A)
bonds_sub: An agreement is final only when you and the buyer both sign. Nobody can change it afterwards.
no_bonds: No agreements yet. Go to Offers and tap “Make agreement”.
c_esc: Price rises up to +{p}% if supply is tight.
c_quality: Quality is checked by photo and by the FPO consultant. If the grade is lower, the price changes to that grade's rate.
c_pay: 50% advance released at signing, 50% held in escrow and paid when the buyer accepts delivery.
toast_signed: Signed. Waiting for the other side.
verified_ok: Verified: nothing was changed after signing
verified_bad: WARNING: terms were changed after signing
err_exceeds_need: The buyer needs less than that.
err_role: This number is registered with the other role.
qc_review: An FPO consultant will check this again.
tip_size: Size is low: ask the consultant about thinning and watering.
tip_colour: Colour is low: harvested too early? Wait a few more days.
tip_blemish: Too many marks: check bagging and spray schedule.
n_req_new: New requirement: {buyer} needs {tons} t Grade {grade} at ₹{price}/kg
n_bond_new: {farmer} committed {tons} t Grade {grade}. Review and sign agreement #{id}.
n_bond_signed: {name} signed agreement #{id}. Your signature is needed.
n_bond_active: Agreement #{id} is final — both sides signed.
n_weather: {alert}: about {tons} t at risk. Open the app for actions.
hist_note: Below: 6-year export history and the 2026 forecast.
wx_line: Next 2 days: {rain} mm rain · wind {wind} km/h · {temp}°C
wx_demo: Weather service unreachable — showing typical values for your district
mandi_none: Live mandi prices are not connected yet, so comparisons use the price model.
price_model_note: Season forecast from the price model; updates as APMC prices come in.
sd_sub: Is Alphonso needed, how much, which grade and when — forecast from a trained model.
sd_plan_line: Offer up to {tons} t Grade {grade} to Singapore — best in {month}
sd_plan_none: Singapore is well supplied with Grade {grade} in your harvest months.
sd_window_gap: Shortage in your harvest months: {gap} t
sd_live: Already confirmed by buyers on AgriLink: {tons} t Grade A ({pct}% of forecast)
sd_no_supply: Supply data covers the Singapore corridor only.
sd_model: Model: gradient boosting trained on {from}–{to} monthly exports ({rows} rows). Tested on {hy}: {err}% error vs {base}% for “same as last year”.
sd_sample: Model data: APEDA-format export series. Connect the live APEDA feed for the latest figures.
pr_sub: What price to expect, how demand changes it, and which buyer to choose.
pr_best_case: With the escalation clause: up to ${usd}/kg
pr_window: Your harvest weeks ({from} – {to}): about ₹{price}/kg. Best week: {best} (₹{bestp}).
pr_fair_ask: Ask buyers for at least ₹{fair}/kg (${usd}) — it covers packing, cold chain and FPO fee (₹{cost}/kg).
pr_costs: Costs used: packing & grading ₹{pg}, cold chain ₹{cc}, documents ₹{dc}, FPO fee ₹{fee} per kg. Local market: {comm}% commission + ₹{tr}/kg transport.
pr_model: Model: gradient boosting on {from}–{to} weekly prices ({rows} rows). Tested on {hy}: {err}% error vs {base}% for “same as last year”.
pr_sample: Model data: weekly price series. Connect Agmarknet / APMC for live prices.
pr_no_offers: No open offers for this grade right now.
pf_sub: What it costs you to grow, what you earn, and how this year compares with past years.
pf_breakeven: Break-even: you need at least ₹{kg}/kg to cover your costs.
pf_profit_local: Profit if you sell all at the local market
pf_chart: Cost per kg vs price per kg (₹)
pf_mine: Your actual costs vs district average
pf_mine_sub: Enter what you spent last season (₹) to see where you can save.
tip_cost_labour: Labour is high: share sprayers and pickers through the FPO and plan harvest days.
tip_cost_fertilizer: Fertilizer is high: get a soil test first and buy in bulk through the FPO.
tip_cost_plant_protection: Sprays are high: follow the FPO spray calendar and avoid extra rounds.
tip_cost_irrigation: Irrigation is high: check pump efficiency; ask about drip or solar-pump schemes.
tip_cost_bagging_materials: Materials are high: buy bags in bulk through the FPO.
tip_cost_harvest_transport: Transport is high: pool transport to the packhouse with neighbours.
pf_model: Model: learned from {from}–{to} cost data ({rows} rows). Tested on {hy}: {err}% error vs {base}% for “same as last year”. Wages +10% → labour cost +{lab}%.
pf_sample: Model data: cost-of-cultivation series. Add your own costs for a closer estimate.
pc_ok: All good — this deal looks safe
pc_profit: Profit · you keep ₹{net}/kg, growing costs ₹{cost}/kg → {profit} on this deal
pc_capacity: Capacity · {tons} t of your {free} t free Grade A
pc_weather_warn: Weather · {alerts} expected — plan an early harvest
pc_loading: Checking demand, price, cost and weather…
th_title: Your minimum price & where to sell
th_baseline: Baseline (break-even): ₹{kg}/kg — below this you lose money
th_offer_min: AgriLink offers: never accept below ${min}/kg — aim for ${target}/kg or more
th_compare: Local market vs other countries — what you keep per kg
th_best: Best for Grade {g}: {m} — you keep ₹{net}/kg ({diff} vs local mandi)
th_note: Country prices are delivered (CIF) prices; air freight, treatment (irradiation USA, VHT Japan) and handling are deducted. Assumed freight: ₹20 + ₹13 per flight hour.
th_banner: Your minimum: ₹{base}/kg (break-even). Don't accept offers below ${min}/kg; aim for ${target}/kg.
lp_sub: Sell to export buyers at fair prices, know the demand before you harvest, and sign secure agreements.
lp_choose: Choose how you want to continue
role_farmer_d: Farmers and FPO members — see offers, demand, prices and profit
role_buyer_d: Importers and retailers — post requirements and sign agreements
login_sub: Enter your mobile number. We will send you a one-time password.
n_contract_sign_request: Agreement {id} is ready for your signature.
n_contract_registered: Agreement {id} is signed by both and registered on the blockchain (block {block}).
n_contract_amended: Agreement {id} was amended — review and sign version {v}.
n_contract_disputed: A dispute was raised on agreement {id}.
n_contract_declined: Agreement {id} was declined and returned to draft.
ag_sub: Formal digital agreements for your commitments. Each is signed by you and the buyer with OTP verification, and its fingerprint is recorded on the blockchain so nobody can change it.
ag_none: No agreements yet. Make an agreement from an offer to start one.
role_ops_d: Quality checks, doctor visits, risks and escrow for every deal
dc_sub: Every deal as one pipeline: market demand, fair price, profit, blockchain agreement, quality, harvest, and escrow payment — checked live in real time.
dc_none: No deals yet. A deal starts when a farmer commits to a buyer requirement.
cert_sub: Every collected lot can carry an AgriLink Quality Certificate with a QR code that anyone can check.
cert_none: No certificates yet. They are issued after your fruit passes quality checks and is collected at the FPO.
cert_basis_1: Each grower's fruit passed AgriLink's quality review for this contract before collection.
cert_basis_2: A farmer doctor inspected the orchard; photo checks were graded by AgriLink's image analysis.
cert_basis_3: Fruit below the contracted grade was separated at the collection point and is not part of this lot.
cert_disclaimer: AgriLink platform quality certificate. It is not an APEDA, AGMARK or GI certificate and does not replace phytosanitary certification.
stg_sub: Record each stage of your crop with photos. AgriLink checks the photos, your farmer doctor reviews, and approved stages get a certificate.
stg_need_batch: Your fruit must be collected into a lot at the FPO first.
stg_submitted: Submitted — your farmer doctor will review
stg_fix: Your farmer doctor asked for a correction. Read the remarks, fix it and submit again.
stg_how1: Fill in the stage record and add clear daylight photos.
stg_how2: AgriLink checks photo quality and, where fruit is visible, blemishes and colour.
stg_how3: Your farmer doctor reviews and approves, rejects or asks for a correction.
stg_how4: Approved stages get a certificate with a QR code.
n_stage_decision_rejected: "{stage}" was rejected by your farmer doctor
n_stage_decision_requires_correction: "{stage}": your farmer doctor asked for a correction
adv_sub: Personal recommendations for your orchard, based on your quality checks, farmer-doctor visits, stage records, weather and your buyer's grade.
adv_spec_none: No clear photo check yet — upload one to compare.
adv_none: No gaps found right now. Keep uploading photo checks so your advice stays up to date.
adv_m2_down: Farm-operations data could not be loaded; advice is based on your stage records and weather only.
adv_disclaimer: Advice is general good practice for Alphonso and is not a diagnosis. Results are not guaranteed; your farmer doctor confirms improvement at the follow-up inspection. Use pesticides only as advised by your KVK and the label.
adv_fu_check: next photo check or farmer-doctor visit
adv_messages_sub: WhatsApp and SMS messages AgriLink sent you, with their delivery status.
adv_compliance_note: {n} measured parameters vs the buyer's grade
adv_no_crop: No crop record yet — start one in Crop stages.
adv_awaiting: Your farmer doctor is reviewing this issue. You will get the steps in your language once they approve them.
adv_help_q: What do you need help with?
adv_not_effective: Your farmer doctor says more work is needed
adv_offline: You are offline — showing your saved advice
adv_queued: Saved on your phone. It will be sent when you are back online.
msg_sim_note: Development/testing mode: this message was not actually sent to your phone.
ev_closed_gap_persists: Closed — re-inspection still shows the gap
prof_lang_note: Advice, WhatsApp and SMS messages use this language.
prof_notify_d: Messages go to {mobile}. Important alerts also come by SMS.
prof_whatsapp_d: Advice, inspection results, reminders and harvest schedules.
prof_sms_d: Only important alerts — works on any phone.
prof_voice_d: Spoken advice in your language on WhatsApp (when available).
n_advisory_help_answered: Your farmer doctor answered your question
